name: Thief Training Room
desc1: A short, weaselly-looking man sits at a table here, nimbly twirling a
desc2: dagger in his hand. As you enter, he swiftly stabs it down into the
desc3: table's surface, and looks you up and down appraisingly. After a short
desc4: moment, he stands up and says "Well? What do you want?" You can exit
desc5: through a doorway to the east.
